//go:build integration

package postgres

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/ports"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/usecase"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
	httptransport "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/transport/http"
)

// Uses actual registered Runtime handlers and PostgreSQL receipts in a random
// disposable schema. Revision, action and lifecycle states are named persistence
// fixtures; this is not a Catalog/Student/Sandbox/validator lifecycle proof.
func TestT13PostgresAssistanceHTTPReplay(t *testing.T) {
	for _, terminal := range []domain.TaskInstanceStatus{domain.TaskInstanceInReview, domain.TaskInstanceCompleted, domain.TaskInstanceCancelled} {
		t.Run(string(terminal), func(t *testing.T) {
			repository, db := openTestRepository(t)
			instance := t13AssistanceInstance(t, repository)
			firstTime := time.Date(2026, 10, 4, 1, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
			body := t13AssistanceBody(instance, testUUID(150), 2)
			first := t13AssistanceRequest(repository, instance.ID, body, true, firstTime)
			if first.Code != http.StatusOK {
				t.Fatalf("first HTTP status=%d", first.Code)
			}
			advanced := t13AssistanceRequest(NewRepository(db), instance.ID, body, true, firstTime.Add(time.Hour))
			if advanced.Code != http.StatusOK || advanced.Body.String() != first.Body.String() {
				t.Fatalf("clock-advanced replay status=%d or receipt changed", advanced.Code)
			}
			var wire struct {
				CreatedAt time.Time `json:"created_at"`
				Policy    string    `json:"policy_version"`
				HintLevel int       `json:"hint_level"`
			}
			if json.Unmarshal(first.Body.Bytes(), &wire) != nil || !wire.CreatedAt.Equal(firstTime) || wire.CreatedAt.Location() != time.UTC || wire.Policy != usecase.AssistancePolicyVersion || wire.HintLevel != 2 {
				t.Fatal("original server facts missing")
			}
			current, err := repository.GetInstance(context.Background(), instance.StudentID, instance.ID)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if terminal != domain.TaskInstanceCancelled {
				// Existing immutable Submit fixture supplies the genuine relational keys;
				// state transitions below seed lifecycle facts without claiming validation.
				submission := t12CommitFeedbackFixture(t, repository, current, 160)
				current, err = repository.GetInstance(context.Background(), instance.StudentID, instance.ID)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				current.Status = domain.TaskInstanceInReview
				current, err = repository.SaveInstance(context.Background(), current)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if terminal == domain.TaskInstanceCompleted {
					current.Status, current.FinalSubmissionID = domain.TaskInstanceFinalizing, submission.ID
					current, err = repository.SaveInstance(context.Background(), current)
					if err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
					current.Status, current.CompletedAt = domain.TaskInstanceCompleted, timePtr(firstTime.Add(2*time.Hour))
				}
			} else {
				current.Status = domain.TaskInstanceCancelled
			}
			if current.Status != domain.TaskInstanceInReview {
				current, err = repository.SaveInstance(context.Background(), current)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			before := current
			replay := t13AssistanceRequest(NewRepository(db), instance.ID, body, true, firstTime.Add(3*time.Hour))
			if replay.Code != http.StatusOK || replay.Body.String() != first.Body.String() {
				t.Fatalf("lifecycle replay status=%d or receipt changed", replay.Code)
			}
			changed := t13AssistanceRequest(NewRepository(db), instance.ID, t13AssistanceBody(instance, testUUID(150), 3), true, firstTime.Add(4*time.Hour))
			if changed.Code != http.StatusConflict {
				t.Fatalf("changed payload status=%d", changed.Code)
			}
			fresh := t13AssistanceRequest(NewRepository(db), instance.ID, t13AssistanceBody(instance, testUUID(151), 2), true, firstTime.Add(4*time.Hour))
			if fresh.Code != http.StatusConflict {
				t.Fatalf("new post-lifecycle fact status=%d", fresh.Code)
			}

			changedStepBody := strings.Replace(body, instance.Steps[0].ID, "absent-step", 1)
			changedStep := t13AssistanceRequest(NewRepository(db), instance.ID, changedStepBody, true, firstTime)
			if changedStep.Code != http.StatusConflict || !strings.Contains(changedStep.Body.String(), "idempotency_conflict") {
				t.Fatal("changed step did not conflict before current guards")
			}
			otherFixture := fixtureInstance()
			otherFixture.ID = testUUID(195)
			otherFixture.StartCommandDigest = "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("c", 64)
			other, _, err := repository.CreateOrLoadStart(context.Background(), otherFixture)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			other.Status = domain.TaskInstanceCancelled
			other, err = repository.SaveInstance(context.Background(), other)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			rebound := t13AssistanceRequest(NewRepository(db), other.ID, t13AssistanceBody(other, testUUID(150), 2), true, firstTime)
			if rebound.Code != http.StatusConflict || !strings.Contains(rebound.Body.String(), "idempotency_conflict") {
				t.Fatal("usage rebound was not rejected before lifecycle guards")
			}
			foreign := instance
			foreign.StudentID = testUUID(999)
			denied := t13AssistanceRequest(NewRepository(db), instance.ID, t13AssistanceBody(foreign, testUUID(150), 2), true, firstTime)
			if denied.Code != http.StatusNotFound {
				t.Fatalf("foreign owner status=%d", denied.Code)
			}
			denied = t13AssistanceRequest(NewRepository(db), instance.ID, body, false, firstTime)
			if denied.Code != http.StatusUnauthorized {
				t.Fatalf("wrong token status=%d", denied.Code)
			}
			// Direct repository replay must authorize its current locked owner, even
			// if a caller presents a self-consistent spoofed instance and receipt.
			stored, digest, err := repository.GetAssistance(context.Background(), instance.StudentID, instance.ID, testUUID(150))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			spoofed := before
			spoofed.StudentID = testUUID(999)
			stored.StudentID = spoofed.StudentID
			if _, _, _, err = repository.RecordAssistance(context.Background(), spoofed, stored, digest); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
				t.Fatalf("transaction owner guard: %v", err)
			}
			after, err := NewRepository(db).GetInstance(context.Background(), instance.StudentID, instance.ID)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(before, after) || after.HintsUsed != 1 || !after.TeacherAssistanceUsed {
				t.Fatal("replay or negative request changed aggregate")
			}
			var count int
			if err := db.QueryRow(`SELECT count(*) FROM practice_assistance_receipts`).Scan(&count); err != nil || count != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("durable fact count=%d err=%v", count, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

type t13AssistanceBarrierRepository struct {
	*Repository
	barrier *sync.WaitGroup
}

func (r *t13AssistanceBarrierRepository) GetAssistance(ctx context.Context, student, instance, usage string) (ports.AssistanceReceipt, string, error) {
	receipt, digest, err := r.Repository.GetAssistance(ctx, student, instance, usage)
	r.barrier.Done()
	r.barrier.Wait()
	return receipt, digest, err
}

func TestT13PostgresAssistanceHTTPConcurrentRuntimeObjects(t *testing.T) {
	for _, sameKey := range []bool{true, false} {
		t.Run(map[bool]string{true: "same_usage", false: "distinct_usage_at_cap"}[sameKey], func(t *testing.T) {
			repo, db := openTestRepository(t)
			instance := t13AssistanceInstance(t, repo)
			n := 8
			if !sameKey {
				n = 2
				instance.HintsUsed = 999
				var err error
				instance, err = repo.SaveInstance(context.Background(), instance)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			beforeVersion := instance.Version
			barrier := &sync.WaitGroup{}
			barrier.Add(n)
			responses := make([]*httptest.ResponseRecorder, n)
			var work sync.WaitGroup
			work.Add(n)
			for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
				go func(i int) {
					defer work.Done()
					usage := testUUID(180)
					if !sameKey {
						usage = testUUID(180 + i)
					}
					responses[i] = t13AssistanceRequest(&t13AssistanceBarrierRepository{Repository: NewRepository(db), barrier: barrier}, instance.ID, t13AssistanceBody(instance, usage, 2), true, time.Date(2026, 10, 4, 1, i, 0, 0, time.UTC))
				}(i)
			}
			work.Wait()
			successes, conflicts := 0, 0
			var first string
			for _, response := range responses {
				switch response.Code {
				case http.StatusOK:
					successes++
					if first == "" {
						first = response.Body.String()
					} else if first != response.Body.String() {
						t.Fatal("concurrent exact replay changed server facts")
					}
				case http.StatusConflict:
					conflicts++
				default:
					t.Fatalf("concurrent HTTP status=%d", response.Code)
				}
			}
			if sameKey && successes != n || !sameKey && (successes != 1 || conflicts != 1) {
				t.Fatalf("successes=%d conflicts=%d", successes, conflicts)
			}
			after, err := NewRepository(db).GetInstance(context.Background(), instance.StudentID, instance.ID)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			wantHints := 1
			if !sameKey {
				wantHints = 1000
			}
			if after.HintsUsed != wantHints || after.Version != beforeVersion+1 || after.MaxHintLevel == nil || *after.MaxHintLevel != 2 || !after.TeacherAssistanceUsed {
				t.Fatal("transaction counted assistance more than once or bypassed cap")
			}
			var count int
			if err := db.QueryRow(`SELECT count(*) FROM practice_assistance_receipts`).Scan(&count); err != nil || count != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("durable fact count=%d err=%v", count, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func t13AssistanceInstance(t *testing.T, repository *Repository) domain.TaskInstance {
	t.Helper()
	instance, _, err := repository.CreateOrLoadStart(context.Background(), fixtureInstance())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	instance.Status = domain.TaskInstanceInProgress
	instance.LearningActionID = testUUID(20)
	instance.AssistancePolicyVersion = usecase.AssistancePolicyVersion
	instance.WorkspaceBinding = domain.WorkspaceBinding{SandboxID: "sandbox-1", Available: true}
	instance.CurrentStep = &instance.Steps[0]
	instance, err = repository.SaveInstance(context.Background(), instance)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return instance
}
func t13AssistanceBody(instance domain.TaskInstance, usage string, hint int) string {
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(struct {
		UsageID    string `json:"usage_id"`
		StudentID  string `json:"student_id"`
		Assistance struct {
			Schema    string `json:"schema"`
			StepID    string `json:"step_id"`
			Kind      string `json:"kind"`
			HintLevel int    `json:"hint_level"`
		} `json:"assistance"`
	}{UsageID: usage, StudentID: instance.StudentID, Assistance: struct {
		Schema    string `json:"schema"`
		StepID    string `json:"step_id"`
		Kind      string `json:"kind"`
		HintLevel int    `json:"hint_level"`
	}{"practice-task-assistance-usage.v1", instance.Steps[0].ID, "HINT", hint}})
	return string(raw)
}
func t13AssistanceRequest(repository ports.Repository, instanceID, body string, authorized bool, now time.Time) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
	server := httptransport.Server{Runtime: &usecase.Runtime{Repository: repository, Now: func() time.Time { return now }}, TeacherToken: "t13-disposable-fixture-token"}
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/internal/task-instances/"+instanceID+"/teacher-assistance", strings.NewReader(body))
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	if authorized {
		request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "t13-disposable-fixture-token")
	}
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	server.Handler().ServeHTTP(response, request)
	return response
}

func TestT13PostgresAssistanceTransactionRechecksNewFactGuards(t *testing.T) {
	for _, guard := range []string{"action", "step", "cap", "lifecycle"} {
		t.Run(guard, func(t *testing.T) {
			repo, _ := openTestRepository(t)
			var current domain.TaskInstance
			var err error
			if guard == "action" {
				current, _, err = repo.CreateOrLoadStart(context.Background(), fixtureInstance())
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				current.Status = domain.TaskInstanceInProgress
				current.AssistancePolicyVersion = usecase.AssistancePolicyVersion
				current, err = repo.SaveInstance(context.Background(), current)
			} else {
				current = t13AssistanceInstance(t, repo)
			}
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			stale := current
			stale.LearningActionID = testUUID(20)
			receipt := ports.AssistanceReceipt{Schema: "practice-task-assistance-usage.v1", UsageID: testUUID(190), StudentID: current.StudentID, TaskInstanceID: current.ID, StepID: current.Steps[0].ID, Kind: "HINT", HintLevel: 2, PolicyVersion: usecase.AssistancePolicyVersion, OccurredAt: time.Now().UTC()}
			switch guard {
			case "step":
				receipt.StepID = "absent-step"
			case "cap":
				current.HintsUsed = 1000
				current, err = repo.SaveInstance(context.Background(), current)
			case "lifecycle":
				current.Status = domain.TaskInstanceCancelled
				current, err = repo.SaveInstance(context.Background(), current)
			}
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			digest, err := domain.CommandDigest(receipt)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			// SaveInstance returns the caller's in-memory representation. PostgreSQL
			// JSONB normalizes embedded RawMessages; that object is not an exact
			// durable baseline. Read both the decoded owner-scoped instance and
			// the complete raw row before the rejected command instead.
			before, err := repo.GetInstance(context.Background(), current.StudentID, current.ID)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			memoryJSON, memoryErr := marshalInstance(current)
			durableJSON, durableErr := marshalInstance(before)
			if !canonicalEqual(memoryJSON, durableJSON, memoryErr, durableErr) {
				t.Fatal("fixture save and durable read differ semantically before command")
			}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(current, before) {
				t.Log("fixture JSONB representation normalized before command; durable baseline captured")
			}
			var rowBefore []byte
			if err := repo.db.QueryRowContext(context.Background(), `SELECT to_jsonb(instance)::text FROM practice_task_instances instance WHERE id=$1`, current.ID).Scan(&rowBefore); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if _, _, _, err = repo.RecordAssistance(context.Background(), stale, receipt, digest); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
				t.Fatalf("transaction %s guard: %v", guard, err)
			}
			after, err := repo.GetInstance(context.Background(), current.StudentID, current.ID)
			if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(before, after) {
				t.Fatal("rejected new fact changed durable aggregate")
			}
			var rowAfter []byte
			if err := repo.db.QueryRowContext(context.Background(), `SELECT to_jsonb(instance)::text FROM practice_task_instances instance WHERE id=$1`, current.ID).Scan(&rowAfter); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			// Includes payload, relational identities, status, version, timestamps
			// and every stored counter. Values remain private to the assertion.
			if !bytes.Equal(rowBefore, rowAfter) {
				t.Fatal("rejected new fact changed raw persisted row")
			}
			var count int
			if err := repo.db.QueryRow(`SELECT count(*) FROM practice_assistance_receipts`).Scan(&count); err != nil || count != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("rejected fact count=%d err=%v", count, err)
			}
		})
	}
}
